maya: Morning team — quick async standup from me. What I did: finished validating the route-muxer perf changes, ran the large-seq perf job, and fixed two flaky CI tests. Blockers: still seeing occasional OOMs on p3-high when sequence > 8k tokens — suspect KV cache leak or a bad quant path. Today: reproduce locally with smaller mem profile, instrument runtime, and open an issue with logs. Ask: @liam can you sanity-check the metrics query I linked? @olivia please pause the canary until I confirm. Link: https://internal.redwood/perf/run/4332
liam: On it — will run the query in ~20m and ping infra. Saw a memory blip at ~09:06 in the dashboard.
priya: Quick update — merged onboarding flow docs PR (#4523). Left a follow-up to tidy the examples. No blockers from product side.
alex: CR ping for runtime batching PR #4528 — small API rename, compatibility shim included. Would appreciate a quick review from eng-runtime before EOD.
olivia: Ack, holding canary. Can you call out what timeframe you expect for the fix so I can schedule the rollout? :eyes:
maya: Hoping to have repro + provisional fix by EOD PT. If not, we'll rollback any partial changes and re-schedule canary.
deploy-bot: Deploy started for canary/group-a at 2026-03-17T09:12:45Z — ID dpl-789
maya: deploy-bot — please cancel dpl-789, that canary was started prematurely.
deploy-bot: Cancel request received for dpl-789. Rollback initiated. Status: rollback_in_progress.
liam: Pulled the metric slice; GPU memory jumps correlate with long prefix reuse. Snippet: ```SELECT gpu_mem FROM metrics WHERE job='route-muxer' AND ts BETWEEN 1710610000 AND 1710611000``` — will attach full chart in thread.
priya: FYI — docs team will push the quickstart update tomorrow morning. If anyone has copy notes, add them to the PR.
sam: No blockers here. I'll take the CR for #4528 after lunch and try to get it green.
olivia: Small ops ask — any objections to moving the weekly infra sync to 10:30 PT? A few folks in APAC asked for slightly later time.
maya: +1 from me for 10:30 PT.
sam: +1.
alex: Works for me.
priya: +1.
maya: Thanks everyone. I'll follow up with a short issue that includes repro steps, the perf run id, and an ETA. If you see any unexpected deploys, call me or post here. :thumbsup:
